THE SEVAGRAD GAZETTE
EASTERN VELTRIA'S INDEPENDENT VOICE
1 JANUARY 1963

A NEW HAND ON THE WHEEL
Region waits to see if rhetoric becomes policy

The eastern provinces watched the inauguration with a mixture of hope and familiar caution. Sevagrad has heard promises from Ashenmere before. Infrastructure investment. Port development. Economic inclusion for the border regions. The promises arrive with every new government and depart with the same regularity.
Chancellor Ashavel's speech made no specific mention of the eastern provinces. This was noted.

Across the border, Morivask state media offered a brief, neutral report of the ceremony — two paragraphs, no analysis. The Tyvaren Confederation's official response was a single line: 'We acknowledge the change of government and expect the continuity of existing agreements.' Diplomatic language for a message that was not entirely warm.

The Gazette congratulates Chancellor Ashavel on her historic election. We remind her, respectfully, that Veltria extends to the eastern coast — and that the people of Sevagrad are part of the Republic she now governs.
